verdict.rationale: Docusign's evidence covers agreement storage, AI clause review, CLM workflow design, and an MCP connector that can 'query agreement status and key dates'. None of it documents tracking renewals, expirations, or obligations, and nothing mentions automatic alerts. Querying key dates through the MCP connector is a developer building block, and central agreement storage is an adjacent feature, so neither delivers the story.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can track contract renewals, expirations, and obligations with automatic alerts
